newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY EASIER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY EASIER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar lost a few points to close weaker against hard currencies on Tuesday but foreign exchange dealers said local trade was quiet, with the unit's movements largely dictated by overseas market trends.

"There wasn't much activity...there were no big payments today. The dollar only lost half a cent (against the key U.S. dollar) because people were quoting high to protect their positions," commented one dealer.

The Zimbabwe dollar closed the day at 10.8175/8325 against the U.S. unit, down from Monday's 10.8150/8300, and was also weaker against pound sterling at 18.3248/3557 compared to 18.2830/3130, tracking a softer U.S. dollar overseas.
It finished at 6.9205/9332 from 6.9040/9120 against the mark and was at 2.3154/3211 versus South Africa's rand from 2.2970/3030.
